meta.note: Structure (scale, radii, control height, component roles) comes from the two apps; the colors replace their blue-800 / Tailwind gray with the Bordeaux identity.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every card, table and dialog (Ivory). Tailwind `--color-body`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, dialogs, menus, inputs.

tokens.name: ink-50
tokens.usage: Table header row, secondary button fill, pinned header. Replaces Tailwind gray-50.

tokens.name: ink-100
tokens.usage: Secondary button hover, gray tag fill, menu item highlight. Replaces gray-100.

tokens.name: ink-200
tokens.usage: The border of every card, menu, popover and dialog; dividers and table rules (not control borders). Replaces gray-200.

tokens.name: ink-300
tokens.usage: EmptyValue dash, skeleton bars. Decorative only: under 3:1 on surface. Replaces gray-300.

tokens.name: ink-400
tokens.usage: Control borders (3.2:1 on surface light, 3.6:1 dark), placeholder icons, disabled menu text. Replaces gray-400.

tokens.name: ink-500
tokens.usage: Field labels, secondary cells, helper text. 6.0:1 on ground, 5.8:1 on ink-50 (light); 7.0:1+ (dark). Replaces gray-500.

tokens.name: ink-600
tokens.usage: Icons in controls, mobile header icon. Replaces gray-600.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Body text inside controls and secondary buttons; gray tag text (9.3:1 on ink-100). Replaces gray-700.

tokens.name: ink-800
tokens.usage: Strong secondary text. Replaces gray-800 (no longer the sidebar: see nav-ground).

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings (Cassis); the column identifying a record. 16.8:1 on ground. Replaces gray-900.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Bordeaux. The one action a screen is for, links, focus ring, active tab underline, spinner. 10.0:1 on surface (light), 8.3:1 (dark).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of a primary button and link.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and primary-hover (10.0:1 light, 8.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary-subtle
tokens.usage: Rosé. Consent summary row, selected list item, active sidebar entry (dark).

tokens.name: on-primary-subtle
tokens.usage: Text on primary-subtle (8.2:1 light, 10.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The one focus ring: 1px ring plus primary border on controls, 2px outline offset 2px on links and buttons.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The key in the mark. Brand moments only (logo keyhole, the flow's brand header accent). Never a status color: warnings are amber.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on gold (9.8:1).

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Fill of a disabled primary or danger button (ink-100 in light).

tokens.name: on-disabled
tokens.usage: Label of a disabled button (5.3:1 light, 5.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, field error message, failure alert text, and the label of a destructive button (red-700). 5.9:1 on danger-subtle.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Failure alert fill and destructive button fill (red-50).

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Failure alert and destructive button border (red-200).

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Fill of a destructive button on hover (red-100). danger reads 5.3:1 on it (light), 6.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning alert text (amber-800). 6.8:1 on warning-subtle.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Warning alert fill (amber-50).

tokens.name: warning-line
tokens.usage: Warning alert border (amber-200).

tokens.name: tag-green
tokens.usage: Tag text for what is enabled or active (green-800), on tag-green-fill.

tokens.name: tag-green-fill
tokens.usage: Tag fill, green.

tokens.name: tag-red
tokens.usage: Tag text for what is disabled, revoked, failed (red-800).

tokens.name: tag-red-fill
tokens.usage: Tag fill, red.

tokens.name: tag-yellow
tokens.usage: Tag text for what needs attention (yellow-800).

tokens.name: tag-yellow-fill
tokens.usage: Tag fill, yellow.

tokens.name: tag-blue
tokens.usage: Tag text for a classification (blue-800).

tokens.name: tag-blue-fill
tokens.usage: Tag fill, blue.

tokens.name: tag-purple
tokens.usage: Tag text for a second classification (purple-800).

tokens.name: tag-purple-fill
tokens.usage: Tag fill, purple.

tokens.name: nav-ground
tokens.usage: Admin sidebar background (Cassis), replacing gray-800.

tokens.name: nav-text
tokens.usage: Sidebar entries (13.5:1 on nav-ground).

tokens.name: nav-muted
tokens.usage: Sidebar section labels and close icon (7.9:1).

tokens.name: nav-disabled
tokens.usage: Sidebar entry the token cannot open (3.6:1; disabled, explained by a HintTooltip).

tokens.name: nav-hover
tokens.usage: Sidebar entry hover.

tokens.name: nav-active
tokens.usage: Current sidebar entry fill, with a 3px gold rule on its left edge (white text 13.8:1).

tokens.name: nav-divider
tokens.usage: Rules between sidebar sections and under its title.

styles.name: flow-brand
styles.usage: The name above the auth card (BasePage). 'Symp' at 500, 'Authy' at 800.

styles.name: flow-title
styles.usage: Title of the auth card (TitleContentCard h1).

styles.name: flow-body
styles.sample: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
styles.usage: Everything an end user reads in the flow: 16px, since many sign in on a phone.

styles.name: flow-label
styles.usage: Field label in ink-700, and a fieldset legend. The admin's FormField draws the same label (text-sm font-medium).

styles.name: flow-small
styles.sample: Don't have an account? Sign Up!
styles.usage: Footer, tagline, helper and error lines under a field.

styles.name: flow-code
styles.usage: One digit box of a validation or TOTP code.

styles.name: admin-screen-title
styles.usage: Title of a screen drawn outside the panel shell (text-2xl font-bold).

styles.name: admin-heading
styles.usage: A DetailSection h2, a dialog h3, the shell's mobile title (text-lg font-semibold).

styles.name: admin-body
styles.sample: Revoking this grant signs the client out of the account.
styles.usage: Everything an operator reads: cells, values, alerts, menu items (text-sm).

styles.name: admin-strong
styles.usage: Tabs, buttons, the primary cell of a row.

styles.name: admin-label
styles.usage: .field-label: uppercase, over a column, a SummaryField, a DefinitionRow (text-xs font-medium tracking-wider uppercase, ink-500).

styles.name: admin-mono
styles.usage: Identifiers, tokens, JSON: the `mono` prop of a cell, field or row.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between two tags (gap-1).

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: A control and the icon inside it (gap-1.5). Half-steps live only inside controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Two controls in a row (gap-2).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Two buttons in a dialog footer; a definition row's block padding; alert padding (p-3).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Two blocks of one screen; card padding below sm:; page padding below lg: (p-4).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Two sections of a record; card padding from sm: (every card, the auth card included); dialog padding; page padding from lg:.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above the flow's brand header (flow page only, never inside a card).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Controls, buttons, menus, alerts, tags, code digit boxes (rounded-md).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Every card in both apps (the flow's auth card included), dialogs, popovers (rounded-lg).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Spinner, avatar initials.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of every control in both apps: buttons, text fields, selects, dropdown triggers (.control, min-h-control). The touch target the flow chose; also a control's minimum width.

tokens.name: auth-card-width
tokens.usage: Max width of the auth card (--max-width-card).

tokens.name: auth-card-width-large
tokens.usage: Max width of a large auth card, e.g. collected claims (--max-width-large-card).

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Admin sidebar (w-64).

tokens.name: page-width
tokens.usage: Where an admin screen stops growing and centres (--container-page, 96rem).
